assumptions.assumption: Configured native CPU identities and CPUID signature/features match the MP CPU records.
assumptions.basis: Production native CPUID projection and Intel MP1.4 section4.3.1.
assumptions.dependent_result: The OS discovers each actual configured CPU with its matching native identity.
assumptions.stress_test: Actual1/2/4 Vmm.new table walk and native guest CPUID/LAPIC reads; independent Linux OS discovery and subsequent all-CPU startup.
assumptions.falsification_probe: Any missing/duplicate CPU record, wrong BSP/identity/signature/features or OS CPU count smaller than configured.
assumptions.status: All6 actual native VMM discovery/startup cases pass. Linux discovers exactly the requested1/2/4 CPU IDs. Complete OS activation requires the separate PIT speaker correction.

assumptions.assumption: Firmware interrupt records must describe the actual default KVM routing and controller profile.
assumptions.basis: Retained Linux6.8 irq_comm.c default_routing, ioapic.c/h and lapic.c; native UAPI image.
assumptions.dependent_result: Explicit IRQ0->input0 and same-numbered remaining ISA routing; actual controller ID/base/version.
assumptions.stress_test: Independent native guest MMIO version/ID reads and Linux IRQ/timer/all-CPU boot.
assumptions.falsification_probe: Native values differ, firmware advertises an unconnected input, or native Linux fails configured IRQ/timer startup.
assumptions.status: Native guest MMIO comparisons, table checks and actual Linux discovery pass. The independently reproduced PIT speaker defect prevents MPS-only Linux timer/startup qualification; complete IRQ/clock correctness is not claimed.

assumptions.assumption: Only cold native direct-kernel boot publishes these reserved firmware bytes.
assumptions.basis: Constructor excludes resume; boot.real_mode distinguishes ISO BIOS boot.
assumptions.dependent_result: Captured RAM and ISO BIOS code remain authoritative in their existing paths.
assumptions.stress_test: Owning ISO boot and checkpoint controls, direct native publication, capacity and rejected-publication memory tests.
assumptions.falsification_probe: Resume regenerates firmware, BIOS code is overwritten or a rejected publish changes memory.
assumptions.status: All3 publication component tests pass, including255 data-layout counts and rejected writes. The canonical PC module and all10 real-mode boot cases pass; source limits publication to cold direct-kernel construction.
